QuestInfo.name: The Burning Golems
QuestInfo.1: Bruce says that all the Frozen Golems must be balanced out by Burning Golems. He wants you to check the Golem's Temple for Burning Golems, and bring some Burning Stones back.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You went back to the Golem's Temple and found Burning Golems, just as Bruce suspected. You defeated the Burning Golems and brought Burning Stones to Jay.

0.0: This is crazy! Are you sure you aren't corrupting my samples? I found a bunch of burning stones in the pile of Frozen Golem bits you brought me last time! It's almost like the universe has two sides to every equation, balancing each other perfectly. No, that's a stupid idea. These must be a fluke! Go back to that Golem's Temple and disprove the existence of the Burning Golems. Go back there and crush 30 of them. I'll need about 15 Burning Stones to figure this out.\r\n

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: This isn't what I asked for at all! You were supposed to DISPROVE them, not prove them further. I'll have to recalibrate everything now. I guess that's just the way this stuff works!\r\n

item.0: Go back over to the Golem's Temple and disassemble more of those Burning Golems. Our research needs to cast a wide net, so about 30 of them should do. I'd say you could get about 15 Burning Stones from that many golems.\r\n

mob.0: Go back over to the Golem's Temple and disassemble more of those Burning Golems. Our research needs to cast a wide net, so about 30 of them should do. I'd say you could get about 15 Burning Stones from that many golems.\r\n
